Anna — thanks for the clear ask. I took this to product and capacity and sketched two pragmatic options that map to what you described. Attached is a short usage export and an initial amendment draft to make the language concrete.

Attachment: usage_report_Q3.csv (CSV, 2.1MB)
Attachment: amendment_draft_v2.docx (Word, 32KB)

High level (summary):
1) Rightsize baseline: commit to a 30% reduction from the originally quoted steady-state tranche based on rolling-average utilization (30-day avg). This lowers your steady commit fee and matches the observed ~35% baseline.
2) Burst pool: a small, reserved burst pool of +20 GPUs (shared, preemptible within the EdgePay account) billed at a lower per-GPU hourly rate when used, capped at X hours/month to control cost. Burst pool keeps tail latency down without forcing full-time provisioning.
3) 90-day review & tranche option: explicit clause allowing a one-time tranche add/remove within 90 days of renewal at pre-agreed pricing bands (documented in amendment).

Operational notes:
- The burst pool uses our Dedicated burst routing — requests are routed to burst GPUs when utilization > 80% for the committed tranche.
- Billing will show burst hours separately in Console with per-token and per-GPU breakdowns.
- We recommend enabling prefix KV caching for high-value flows to reduce token load during spikes; Dev included short config notes below.

Next steps: I can jump on a 30m call Thurs to walk through the amendment and the cost delta. Marissa and Dev are looped for pricing and config details.

Cheers,
Jonas

Anna — quick tech follow-up on the burst behavior and the KV caching suggestion:

- Burst routing: requests over 80% committed tranche utilization will be routed to the burst pool automatically. We maintain KV cache affinity during routing so the tail latency impact is minimized.
- Preemption model: burst GPUs are lower-priority; if other Dedicated customers need emergency capacity we will do a graceful drain with a 10-minute window. We include an SLA credit if preemption results in >1% error rate for more than 30 minutes in a billing cycle.
- Telemetry & metrics: we’ll add a dedicated dashboard tile for 95th/99th GPU utilization, per-route latency, and burst-hours.

Config snippet (attach to Console template):
- enable_prefix_kv: true
- kv_affinity_window: 12h
- burst_threshold_pct: 80
- burst_capacity_pool: 20 (GPUs)
